scripts.build: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then napi build --release --platform; else echo '⚠️ cargo not found, skipping native build (install Rust to build)'; fi
scripts.build:debug: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then napi build; else echo '⚠️ cargo not found, skipping native build'; fi
scripts.build:wasm: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then napi build --release --target wasm32-wasip1-threads; else echo '⚠️ cargo not found, skipping WASM build'; fi
